_comment: DESIGN.md §7 and §18, extended. Every ability in the game. The shape of an entry is in src/data/abilities.ts: a trigger (WHEN), a target (WHO), effects (WHAT) and a price. Numbers are named in `numbers` and referred to as "@name", so `ranks` can raise one figure per tier without restating the ability - rank 1 is `numbers` as written, rank 2 is `numbers` with ranks[1] laid over it. All placeholders, like every number in data/.
_tags: Tags are the synergy channel. `burning` is Pyre's, applied by Kindle, Emberdust, Wildfire, Cinderburst, Conflagration and Pyroclasm and paid off by Firestorm and Conflagration (more damage) and Wildfire (spreads only to what already burns). `blighted` is Thornweald's, from Bloomspread and Wilt, paid off by Heartpiercer. `soaked` is Gloomtide's, from Snarekelp and Sleetfall, paid off by Torrential, Hailburst, Undertow and Drownward. A builder that applies its own tag and then exploits it is a builder whose units want to be built together, which is the point.
_planned: The `planned` list at the bottom uses effect kinds the simulation does not honour yet (IMPLEMENTED_EFFECTS in abilities.ts is the live set). They are designs kept where the thinking is, and validate.ts refuses to let a unit, monster or send reference one - so nothing the panel shows a player is a promise rather than a rule.

control._comment: §18's diminishing returns, so a table of stun units cannot hold a wave still forever. The first control effect inside `windowSeconds` lasts its full duration, the second half of it, and so on down `scale`; once the list is spent the body cannot be controlled at all for `immuneSeconds`. Counted per body, and the showdown dampens the durations on top of this (§3.3, replaced).

energy._comment: The resource the expensive abilities spend (§18). Every body has the same pool, fills it passively, and tops it up on a kill - so an active ability fires on a rhythm set by the fight rather than by a bare cooldown, and a unit that is not killing anything fires it less often. A full pool lasts most of a wave fight, so energy on its own is rarely what holds an ability back: Gloomtide's Deepcall grants it AND brings its allies' clocks forward (`recharge`), and the second half is the one that shows (BALANCE.md §4j).

abilities.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
abilities.text: Allies standing close hit harder and hold firmer, and it stacks.
abilities.description: Up to {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of the Pledge, nearest first, deal {damage%} more damage and take {guard%} less for as long as they stay in range. The Pledge doesn't buff itself. Each Pledge can give an ally only one stack of each, but an ally standing near several Pledges can carry up to {effects.0.stacks.max}, and the stacks multiply together.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: Drags the enemies around its target onto itself, and holds them there weak and open.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the Oathwall's current target, nearest to that target first, are taunted for {hold} seconds. A taunted enemy has to attack the Oathwall, and walks over to it if it can't reach it from where it stands. For the same {hold} seconds it deals {weaken%} less damage and takes {exposed%} more damage from everything.

abilities.name: Unbroken
abilities.text: Badly wounded, nothing holds it and blows start glancing off.
abilities.description: The first time the Oathwall drops below {trigger.fraction%} health, it takes {reduction%} less damage, dodges {evasion%} of the attacks aimed at it and can't be stunned, rooted or taunted, all for {duration} seconds. It can only trigger again once its health has climbed back above {trigger.fraction%}, or after it respawns for the next wave.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.text: Its spear turns blows aside, for itself and the allies beside it.
abilities.description: The Sentinel and the allies nearest it within {radius} tiles, {allies} in all counting the Sentinel, dodge {chance%} of the attacks aimed at them, and a dodged attack does no damage at all. Ability damage and burns can't be dodged. An ally near two Sentinels only gets the bonus once.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.text: Every blow that lands on it or the allies beside it is answered.
abilities.description: The Sentinel and the allies nearest it within {radius} tiles, {allies} in all counting the Sentinel, hit back at whatever attacks them: {share%} of the damage each attack does to them goes straight back to the attacker, through its armor. Damage from abilities and burns isn't returned. An ally near two Sentinels only gets this once.

abilities.name: Verdict
abilities.text: Every shot takes a slice of whatever it is aimed at, however big.
abilities.description: Each of the Judgement's attacks also deals {share%} of the target's maximum health as extra damage, up to {cap} times the Judgement's own attack damage, so it hits big enemies as hard, in proportion, as small ones until they are very big indeed.

abilities.name: Final Sentence
abilities.text: The blow carries to everything near its target, and finishes what it leaves weak.
abilities.description: After each of the Judgement's attacks, once the attack and Verdict have both landed, the blow carries on to up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, nearest to it first and the target included if it's still standing. Each of them takes {share%} of the Judgement's attack damage, and then any of them left at or below {threshold%} of its maximum health is killed outright. Nothing reduces the finishing blow, but an enemy that is immune to abilities can't be reached this way.

abilities.name: Censure
abilities.text: The blast leaves everything near it hitting softer.
abilities.description: Each attack weakens up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, the target included, nearest first. A weakened enemy deals {weaken%} less damage for {duration} seconds. Hitting an enemy that is already weakened resets its timer rather than stacking.

abilities.name: Interdict
abilities.text: Everything in the circle stops where it stands.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Sanction stuns up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of its current target, nearest first, for {hold:second:seconds}. A stunned enemy can't move, attack or use abilities.

abilities.name: Warding Light
abilities.text: Wards the allies furthest forward against the next blows that land.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, the Vigil wards the {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of it that stand furthest forward, toward the enemy. Each ward soaks up to {absorbs%} of the warded ally's maximum health from each of the next {blocks:attack:attacks}, then breaks, or fades after {duration} seconds if nothing hits the ally. A blow smaller than that is stopped entirely; a bigger one goes through, less what the ward soaked. Warding an ally that still has its ward only resets the timer. Wards don't stop burns or ability damage, and the Vigil never wards itself.

abilities.name: Absolution
abilities.text: Nothing holds the allies furthest forward, and their wounds close.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Vigil picks the {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of it that stand furthest forward. Each of them heals {heal%} of its maximum health and can't be stunned, rooted or taunted for {duration} seconds. A stun that is already holding one of them isn't broken, but nothing new can land.

abilities.name: Closing Ranks
abilities.text: The line beside it hits harder and takes less, for a few seconds.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Pledge rallies up to {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first. For {duration} seconds they deal {damage%} more damage and take {reduction%} less. The Pledge doesn't rally itself.

abilities.name: Kindle
abilities.text: Sets what it touches burning. Burns stack.
abilities.description: Each attack sets the target burning for {burn} blast damage per second over {duration} seconds. Every attack adds another burn, up to {effects.0.stacks.max} at a time, and each one burns on its own. Once the target carries {effects.0.stacks.max}, a new attack resets the timer on the burn closest to running out instead.

abilities.name: Molten Hide
abilities.text: Its hide gives back a share of every blow that lands on it.
abilities.description: Whenever an attack damages the Slagmaw, the attacker takes {share%} of the damage that actually landed, as damage that ignores armor. Only attacks are sent back, not burns or ability damage, and damage sent back is never reflected again.

abilities.name: Cinderburst
abilities.text: Goes out loudly, and takes the crowd around it with it.
abilities.description: When the Slagmaw dies, up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first, take {damage} blast damage and start burning for {burn} blast damage per second over {effects.1.durationSeconds} seconds.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.text: Its shells scatter fire, and fire falls hardest on what is already alight.
abilities.description: Each shell splashes onto up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, the target included, nearest first. The first takes {share%} of the Firebrand's attack damage as blast damage, and each one after that takes {falloff%} of what the one before it took. An enemy that is already burning takes {bonus} times as much.
abilities._note: Cut after the full-run sweep: a pair of Firebrands cleared waves 2 to 4 in five to eleven seconds where every other rung-5 pair failed wave 3. A 466 shell one-shots anything small, so the SHARE barely matters against a crowd - the number of bodies the splash reaches is the whole of it. Three at Mark I and II, four at Mark III.

abilities.name: Spitfire
abilities.text: One shot, two mouths to feed.
abilities.description: Each attack jumps on from the target to the nearest other enemy within {radius} tiles of it, making up to {jumps:jump:jumps}, each from the last enemy hit to the nearest one it hasn't hit yet. The first enemy it jumps to takes {share%} of the Wickling's attack damage times {falloff} as blast damage, and each jump after that multiplies by {falloff} again. The target itself takes nothing extra.
abilities._note: Priced down after the wave sweep. Pyre’s cheap half is the only one in the game whose three abilities are ALL offence and ALL on-attack, and two of them hit more than one body. Against thirty monsters arriving together that is worth far more than a slow, an evade or a shield, which is what the other three builders have there - Pyre cleared 73-95% of its armies at every one of the first five waves against 23-75% for everyone else, while carrying 11% fewer raw stats. The bodies were not the problem.

abilities.name: Emberdust
abilities.text: Scatters embers off each shot, and what they land on catches.
abilities.description: Each attack has a {chance%} chance to scatter embers over up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, nearest first and the target included. Each of them burns for {burn%} of the Wickling's attack damage as blast damage every second for {effects.0.durationSeconds} seconds. One enemy can carry up to {effects.0.stacks.max} of these burns at once.

abilities.name: Stoke
abilities.text: The longer it fires the faster and sharper it fires. Stop, and it cools.
abilities.description: Every attack gives the Scoria a stack of heat that lasts {window} seconds. Each stack makes it attack {step%} faster and adds {crit%} to its chance of landing a critical hit, which deals double damage. It holds up to {max} stacks; at the cap, a new attack renews the stack closest to running out. Attack speed from the stacks multiplies together, so the heat keeps climbing while it fires and drops away once it stops.

abilities.name: Slagshot
abilities.text: Now and then a round of molten slag splashes the crowd around its target.
abilities.description: Each attack has a {chance%} chance to throw a round of slag as well, hitting up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, nearest to it first and the target included if it's still standing, for {share%} of the Scoria's attack damage as blast damage.

abilities.name: Wildfire
abilities.text: Carries a fire from one body to the next, but only to what already burns.
abilities.description: Each attack spreads fire from the target to the nearest other burning enemy within {radius} tiles of it, making up to {jumps:jump:jumps}, each from the last enemy reached to the nearest burning one it hasn't reached yet. Every enemy it reaches burns for an extra {burn} blast damage per second over {duration} seconds, stacking up to {effects.0.stacks.max} times. It never reaches an enemy that isn't burning, and it doesn't add a burn to the target itself.
abilities._note: Priced down after the wave sweep. Pyre’s cheap half is the only one in the game whose three abilities are ALL offence and ALL on-attack, and two of them hit more than one body. Against thirty monsters arriving together that is worth far more than a slow, an evade or a shield, which is what the other three builders have there - Pyre cleared 73-95% of its armies at every one of the first five waves against 23-75% for everyone else, while carrying 11% fewer raw stats. The bodies were not the problem.

abilities.name: Emberwind
abilities.text: The heat it throws off lifts everything fighting beside it.
abilities.description: Up to {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of the Foxfire, nearest first, deal {damage%} more damage while they stay in range. The Foxfire doesn't buff itself, and an ally near two of them only gets the bonus once.

abilities.name: Conflagration
abilities.text: Everything near it catches at once; what was burning catches worse.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Ember sets off a blaze around its current target. Up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of that target, nearest first, take {share%} of the Ember's attack damage as blast damage, or {bonus} times that if they were already burning. All of them then burn for {burn} blast damage per second over {effects.1.durationSeconds} seconds.

abilities.name: Pyroclasm
abilities.text: Empties its throat in a cone and leaves the ground alight.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Firebrand empties a {degrees}-degree cone, {length} tiles long, toward its current target. Up to {targets} enemies inside it, nearest first, take {share%} of the Firebrand's attack damage as blast damage and burn for {burn} blast damage per second over {effects.1.durationSeconds} seconds. Each enemy after the first takes {falloff%} of what the one before it took, burn included.
abilities._note: Share cut from 1.4 in the stat pass (BALANCE.md §4f): Firebrand III was 16% ahead of the rung 5 Mark IIIs at +22% of its ladder price, and the cone - eight bodies at 140% of the shell - is what Mark III adds.

abilities.name: Rootbite
abilities.text: Its bite runs roots through the ground, and everything near it swings slower.
abilities.description: Each attack slows the attacks of up to {targets} enemies within {radius:tile:tiles} of the target, nearest first and the target included, by {chill%} for {duration} seconds. Each mark of Thornling adds its own stack, up to {effects.0.stacks.max}, so a mix of Thornlings, Super Thornlings and Ultra Thornlings slows harder than a crowd of one kind. Stacks multiply together, and another bite from the same kind of Thornling only resets its stack's timer.

abilities.name: Heartwood
abilities.text: Closes its own wounds, slowly and without being asked.
abilities.description: The Hollowbark heals {rate%} of its maximum health every second, all the time, including in the middle of a fight. It can't heal above its maximum.
abilities._note: Halved after the full-run sweep. At 1.2% of maximum health a second a Hollowbark healed 29 a second, and two of them - 356 gold, against a wave-4 nominal of 650 - beat waves 2, 3 and 4 alone by out-healing them, in 60-second grinds. No other rung-4 pair cleared wave 3. It was also how a player could starve their army to build economy for four waves and not be punished for it. The higher ranks came down further after that, because the rate is a share of MAXIMUM health and so grows with the mark: at 1% a Hollowbark II healed 70 a second on its own, and stacked with a Mycelia III’s Underweb it was over 130.

abilities.name: Thicket
abilities.text: Whatever is hitting it gets tangled in it.
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy damages the Hollowbark, that enemy attacks {slow%} slower for {duration} seconds. Any damage counts, burns and ability hits included, and more damage only resets the timer.

abilities.name: Bloomspread
abilities.text: Blights the crowd around what it hits. Blighted flesh takes everything harder.
abilities.description: Each attack blights up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, the target included, nearest first. A blighted enemy takes {vulnerable%} more damage from everything for {duration} seconds. Each mark of Sporecrown can add its own stack, up to {effects.0.stacks.max}, and the stacks multiply; another hit from the same kind only resets its stack's timer.

abilities.name: Underweb
abilities.text: Threads the ground under the line: whoever stands on it is bigger, and mending.
abilities.description: Up to {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of the Mycelia, nearest first, get {bulk%} more maximum health and heal {rate%} of their maximum health every second while they stay in range. The extra maximum health arrives with the same amount of current health, and both go when the ally leaves. The Mycelia doesn't affect itself, and an ally near two of them only gets one Underweb.
abilities._note: Regeneration halved after the full-run sweep. At 1.8% of maximum health a second on four allies it stacked with a Hollowbark’s own Heartwood into a wall healing nearly 200 a second, and a Mycelia III with two Hollowbark IIs - three bodies - held wave 8 through a 91-second grind while the rest of the gold went into the economy.

abilities.name: Sporebloom
abilities.text: Dying, it opens, and the line around it closes up.
abilities.description: When the Mycelia dies, up to {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first, each heal {heal%} of their own maximum health.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.text: Each shot drives on through its target, into whatever stands behind.
abilities.description: Each attack drives on in a line {length} tiles long and {width:tile:tiles} wide, running from the Nettlespire toward its target. Up to {targets} enemies in that line, nearest the Nettlespire first, take {share%} of its attack damage, each one after the first {falloff%} of what the one before it took. The target is in the line too if the shot didn't kill it.

abilities.name: Wilt
abilities.text: What it hits withers, and so does what stands near it: softer blows, poorer healing.
abilities.description: Each attack withers up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, nearest first and the target included. For {duration} seconds a withered enemy deals {weaken%} less damage, has the healing it gets from heals and regeneration cut by {antiheal%}, and is marked as blighted. Lifesteal isn't affected. Withering it again resets the timers.

abilities.name: Burstspore
abilities.text: What it kills bursts, and the spores keep working.
abilities.description: Whenever the Rotgourd kills an enemy, the body bursts: up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first, take {share%} of the Rotgourd's attack damage as arcane damage, then rot for {rot%} of its attack damage as arcane damage every second for {effects.1.durationSeconds} seconds. The rot marks them as blighted.

abilities.name: Heartpiercer
abilities.text: One shot straight through the armor, worth a slice of what it hit.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Nettlespire shoots whatever it is currently aiming at, whether or not it's in range yet, for {share%} of that target's maximum health, up to {cap} times the Nettlespire's own attack damage. The shot ignores armor, the damage chart and every damage reduction on the target. A blighted target takes {bonus} times as much.

abilities.name: Bindroot
abilities.text: The ground closes round them and holds them still.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Thornling stuns up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of its current target, nearest first, for {hold:second:seconds}. A stunned enemy can't move, attack or use abilities.

abilities.name: Blightbloom
abilities.text: Opens every bloom at once: the rot spreads, holds, and stops them mending.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Sporecrown opens every bloom around its current target. Up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of that target, nearest first, rot for {rot%} of the Sporecrown's attack damage as arcane damage every second, take {vulnerable%} more damage from everything and get {antiheal%} less healing from heals and regeneration, all for {duration} seconds. The rot marks them as blighted.

abilities.name: Anchorline
abilities.text: Throws its chain and holds what it catches, dragging on every swing.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, the Fathomhold roots up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of its current target, nearest first, for {hold} seconds, and they deal {weaken%} less damage while it holds them. A rooted enemy can't move, but it can still attack.

abilities.name: Deadweight
abilities.text: Too heavy to shift and too cold to hurt quickly.
abilities.description: The Fathomhold takes {reduction%} less damage and can never be stunned, rooted or taunted. Damage that ignores armor isn't reduced.

abilities.name: Snarekelp
abilities.text: Waterlogs what it hits and what stands beside it: slower to swing, easier to hurt.
abilities.description: Each attack soaks up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, the target first, for {duration} seconds: they attack {slow%} slower and take {soak%} more damage from everything. Each mark of Kelpsnare can add its own stack of each, up to {effects.0.stacks.max}, and the stacks multiply; another hit from the same kind only resets its stacks' timers.

abilities.name: Weedbind
abilities.text: Dying, it drags everything around it down with it for a moment.
abilities.description: When the Kelpsnare dies, its kelp grabs up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first, and stuns them for {hold:second:seconds}. A stunned enemy can't move, attack or use abilities.

abilities.name: Torrential
abilities.text: The fall runs in a line toward its mark, and soaked ground carries it.
abilities.description: Each attack also sends a strip of water {width} tiles wide and {length} tiles long out from the Torrent, pointed at its target. Up to {targets} enemies standing in the strip, nearest the Torrent first, take {share%} of its attack damage as blast damage, each one after the first taking {falloff%} of what the one before it took. Soaked enemies take {bonus} times as much.

abilities.name: Sleetfall
abilities.text: Cold enough to slow a swing, and it soaks everything under it.
abilities.description: Each attack chills up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, the target included, nearest first. A chilled enemy attacks {chill%} slower for {duration} seconds and is marked as soaked. Each mark of Sleet can add its own stack, up to {effects.0.stacks.max}, and the stacks multiply; another hit from the same kind only resets its stack's timer.

abilities.name: Hailburst
abilities.text: Hail on a soaked body hits half again as hard.
abilities.description: Each attack also drops hail on up to {targets} enemies within {radius} tiles of the target, the target included, nearest first. Each takes {share%} of the Sleet's attack damage as blast damage, or {bonus} times that if it's soaked.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.text: Runs from one soaked body to the next, taking a share from each.
abilities.description: Each attack runs on from the target to the nearest other soaked enemy within {radius} tiles of it, making up to {jumps:jump:jumps}, each from the last enemy reached to the nearest soaked one it hasn't reached yet. The first enemy it reaches takes {share%} of the Maelstrom's attack damage times {falloff} as arcane damage, and each jump after that multiplies by {falloff} again. It only ever reaches soaked enemies, and it doesn't hit the target itself.

abilities.name: Drownward
abilities.text: Pressure, not injury: it takes a share of whatever is left.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Maelstrom hits whatever it is currently aiming at for {share%} of the health that target has left, up to {cap} times the Maelstrom's own attack damage, as arcane damage. A soaked target takes {bonus} times as much.
abilities._note: Raised from 8% in the stat pass (BALANCE.md §4f): Maelstrom III was 13% behind its rung-mates at 18% under its ladder price, and this was the whole of what its Mark III added.

abilities.name: Cloudburst
abilities.text: Opens the whole sky along one line and leaves it soaked.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Torrent opens a strip of rain {width} tiles wide and {length} tiles long, running out from it toward its current target. Up to {targets} enemies in the strip, nearest the Torrent first, take {share%} of its attack damage as blast damage, move {slow%} slower for {duration} seconds and are marked as soaked. Each enemy after the first takes {falloff%} of what the one before it took, and gets that share of the slow.
abilities._note: Share cut from 0.85 in the stat pass (BALANCE.md §4f): Torrent III did 26% more for its gold than any other rung 6 Mark III with its price at +23%, and the jump came at Mark III, which is where this arrives - six bodies at 85% of a 5,800 shell every eight seconds. Cut again to 0.4 in the ability audit (BALANCE.md §4j), where it was the strongest thing Torrent III did.

abilities.name: Tidesong
abilities.text: Keeps time for the line. Everything near it swings faster.
abilities.description: Up to {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of the Murmur, nearest first, attack {haste%} faster while they stay in range. The Murmur doesn't speed up itself, and an ally near two of them only gets the bonus once.

abilities.name: Deepcall
abilities.text: Calls something up from below, and the line's abilities come round sooner.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, if it has {energyCost} energy, the Murmur calls on up to {allies} allies within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first. Each gets {energy} energy, and every ability it is waiting on comes {recharge} seconds closer to ready. Nobody can hold more than the maximum energy, and an ability that costs energy still has to pay for it. The Murmur doesn't call on itself.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.text: Bursts on death and sprays everything close.
abilities.description: When the Bloater dies, it bursts over up to {targets} units within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first, dealing {share%} of its attack damage to each as blast damage.
abilities._note: A share of the Bloater's own hit rather than a flat 60, since waves 11 to 15. Monsters grow every wave and a flat number does not: 60 was a Bloater hit and a half at wave 1 and a sixth of one by wave 15, so the thing a wave of Bloaters asks for - do not let them die in the middle of your melee - stopped being asked. 1.6 is the old burst at the Bloater's wave-1 hit.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.text: Stands back and closes the worst wound it can see.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, the Mender heals the most wounded monster within {radius} tiles of it, judged by the share of health it has lost, for {share%} of that monster's maximum health. It never heals itself.
abilities._note: The Mender's. A share of the PATIENT's maximum, so it grows with whatever it is standing behind - a grub, a Bloater, a boss - and the most wounded body in reach is the one it picks, which is always the one the defence is trying to finish. It reaches further than the Mender shoots, so it heals the front line from behind it.

abilities.name: Unhallowed
abilities.text: Abilities slide off it. Only plain damage works.
abilities.description: No ability can touch the Revenant. It can't be targeted by anything an ability does, so burns, slows, stuns, ability damage and even buffs from other monsters all pass it by. Only plain attacks hurt it.

abilities.name: Plated Shell
abilities.text: Everything lands a little softer on that shell.
abilities.description: The Carapace takes {reduction%} less damage. Damage that ignores armor isn't reduced.

abilities.name: Dampening Field
abilities.text: The defence around it swings noticeably slower.
abilities.description: Up to {targets} units within {radius} tiles of the Warden, nearest first, attack {slow%} slower while they stay in range. A unit near two Wardens is only slowed once.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.text: Arrives at a sprint and keeps it up for a while.
abilities.description: When it arrives on the field it moves {haste%} faster, for its first {duration} seconds.

abilities.name: Brood Surge
abilities.text: Wounding it makes it worse.
abilities.description: The first time the Brood Sire drops below {trigger.fraction%} health, it attacks {haste%} faster and deals {damage%} more damage for {duration} seconds.

abilities.name: Hollow Cry
abilities.text: Screams, and the line in front of it stops dead for a moment.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, the Hollow King screams. Up to {targets} units within {radius} tiles of the unit it is targeting, nearest first, are stunned for {hold:second:seconds}. When it isn't targeting a unit, the scream is centred on itself.

abilities.name: Grave Tithe
abilities.text: Takes a tithe of every wound it deals and keeps it.
abilities.description: The Gravemother heals for {share%} of the damage its attacks deal.

abilities.name: Chitin Ward
abilities.text: Once it is hurt badly enough, nothing holds it any more.
abilities.description: The first time the Chitin Lord drops below {trigger.fraction%} health, it can't be stunned, rooted or taunted and takes {reduction%} less damage, both for {duration} seconds.

abilities.name: Siegework
abilities.text: Sent braced for a wall: harder to shift than one that walked in.
abilities.description: It takes {reduction%} less damage. Damage that ignores armor isn't reduced.

abilities.name: Raider's Haste
abilities.text: Paid to be somewhere quickly.
abilities.description: When it arrives on the field it moves {haste%} faster, for its first {duration} seconds.

abilities.name: Volatile Cargo
abilities.text: Packed with whatever was cheapest. It does not land quietly.
abilities.description: When it dies, it explodes over up to {targets} units within {radius} tiles of it, nearest first, dealing {share%} of its attack damage to each as blast damage.
abilities._note: A share of the Bloater's own hit rather than a flat 110, like Rupture: a flat number stops mattering as the waves grow, and a Bloater sent at wave 20 burst for a thirtieth of what one hits for. 2.9 is the old burst at the Bloater's wave-1 hit.

abilities.name: Flicker
abilities.text: Hard to pin down: a share of the blows aimed at it find nothing.
abilities.description: It dodges {evasion%} of the attacks aimed at it, and a dodged attack does no damage at all. Ability damage and burns can't be dodged.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.text: Whatever it bites swings slower for a while.
abilities.description: Each of its attacks makes the unit it hits attack {slow%} slower for {duration} seconds. Another hit resets the timer rather than stacking.

abilities.name: Corrode
abilities.text: Its spit eats armor: what it hits takes more from everything.
abilities.description: Each of its attacks makes the unit it hits take {vulnerable%} more damage from everything for {duration} seconds. Another hit resets the timer rather than stacking.

abilities.name: Bulwark
abilities.text: The pack around it takes every blow a little softer.
abilities.description: Every monster within {radius} tiles of it, itself included, takes {reduction%} less damage while it stays in range. A monster inside two of these is only protected once, and damage that ignores armor isn't reduced.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.text: The pack around it closes its wounds as it walks.
abilities.description: Every monster within {radius} tiles of it, itself included, heals {rate%} of its maximum health every second while it stays in range. A monster inside two of these only heals once.

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.text: The pack around it marches faster and swings faster.
abilities.description: Every monster within {radius} tiles of the Herald, the Herald included, moves {haste%} faster and attacks {fury%} faster while it stays in range. A monster near two Heralds only gets this once.

abilities.name: Iron Will
abilities.text: Nothing near it can be stunned, rooted or held.
abilities.description: Every monster within {radius} tiles of the Bastion, the Bastion included, can't be stunned, rooted or taunted while it stays in range. Slows still work on them.

abilities.name: Trample
abilities.text: Every few steps it stamps, and everything under it is hurt.
abilities.description: Every {period} seconds, the Behemoth stamps. Up to {targets} units within {radius} tiles of the unit it is targeting, nearest first, take {share%} of its attack damage as blast damage. When it isn't targeting a unit, the stamp lands around itself.

planned.name: Reclaim
planned.text: Raises a fallen ally as a sapling that fights until it withers.

planned.name: Sapling Bloom
planned.text: Puts up saplings of its own while it has the energy for it.

planned.name: Undertide
planned.text: Drags everything in front of it back down the lane.

planned.name: Breakwater
planned.text: Throws up a wall of ice that has to be broken before anything gets past.

planned.name: Heat Death
planned.text: Burns through its own body and comes back as something worse.

planned.name: Tidebond
planned.text: Ties itself to an ally: what one of them takes, both of them share.

planned.name: Detonate
planned.text: Marks a body, counts what it takes, and gives it all back at once.

planned.name: Quartermaster
planned.text: Building near it is cheaper, and selling it back costs less than it should.

planned.name: Devour
planned.text: Swallows something small whole, then spends a while digesting it.

planned.name: Recall Tide
planned.text: Sends one body back to the mouth of the lane to walk it again.

_text: Every `text` is ONE SHORT SENTENCE saying what the ability is for, and carries no numbers; a test caps it at 90 characters. Every `description` is the ability in full, in plain sentences, exact enough to rebuild it from - and its numbers are `{placeholders}` filled from the resolved ability at the unit's rank (fillDescription in src/data/abilities.ts), so the card and the data cannot disagree and a balance pass never leaves a stale figure behind. `{radius}` reads `numbers`, `{effects.0.durationSeconds}` reads the resolved ability, `{slow%}` writes a fraction as an unsigned percentage, and `{jumps:jump:jumps}` adds the noun that agrees with the number.
